purpose: Rank current market signals by historical abnormality.

scoring.market_regime_score: weighted normalized combination of correlation, rates, volatility, credit, commodities and FX anomalies

suggested_live_sources.market_prices: Polygon, Twelve Data, Tiingo, Financial Modeling Prep or paid institutional feed
suggested_live_sources.credit: FRED ICE BofA OAS series / institutional feed

what_changed_today.goal: Separate high absolute levels from genuinely new daily changes.
what_changed_today.ranking: Sort by absolute Delta Score, then flag improving vs deteriorating.
what_changed_today.interpretation: Highlight interactions between signals, not only individual moves.

risk_bias_horizons.1D: fastest response; highest sensitivity to momentum, rates, correlation and volatility
risk_bias_horizons.1W: moderated short-term stress; more emphasis on persistence
risk_bias_horizons.1M: lower sensitivity to daily shocks; higher emphasis on broader trend and credit persistence

regime_divergence_alert.MID: one horizon differs by one regime step
regime_divergence_alert.HIGH: direct BULLISH vs BEARISH disagreement across horizons
regime_divergence_alert.purpose: Distinguish temporary shocks from genuine regime changes.

volatility_regime.future_live_logic: Compute realized vol directly from SPY/SPX returns; fetch implied-volatility indices separately.

rates_regime.narrative_logic: Separate real-yield shocks from inflation-expectation shocks and identify whether front-end, belly, or long-end drives the move.

sector_allocation_engine.guardrail: Relative regime score only; combine with valuation, earnings revisions and price momentum.

portfolio_modes: Top-3 long / Bottom-3 short with 50% / 25% / 25% on each side
Extreme conviction: +200% best-ranked sector / -200% worst-ranked sector
backtest_engine.current_ui_note: Displayed performance is illustrative until historical live data are connected.

data_sources.macro: FRED CSV series DGS2, DGS10, DFII10, T10YIE, VIXCLS, BAMLH0A0HYM2

backtest_engine.signal_timing: Signals computed at month-end t; portfolio return measured from t to t+1.

extreme_mode.purpose: Test ranking power at the extremes.

ui_controls.rebalance: monthly live; weekly/quarterly visible but return explicit not-implemented error

fallback_benchmark.method: annual return converted to compounded period return for local interactive display
fallback_benchmark.note: Live API mode remains preferred for true daily/monthly path.

backtest_engine.pricing: Twelve Data time_series with adjust=all (splits + dividends)
backtest_engine.short_borrow: user-selectable assumption in basis points per year
backtest_engine.missing_data_policy: Return Data unavailable; never fabricate performance.
backtest_engine.fred_access: Public FRED CSV, no API key required

rotation_history.holdings_history: show top and bottom sectors for each rebalance date

regime_playbook.purpose: Translate rates, volatility, credit, inflation and momentum regimes into sector and style preferences.
outputs: scenario triggers that change the recommendation

fx_regime.playbook_role: Confirmation layer for global risk appetite, liquidity and commodity/growth signals.
